message: As a parent, I know how important it is to keep our little ones safe, especially when it comes to fire safety. The kids may think they know it all, but it's up to us to guide them on what to do in case of an emergency. 🏠 I found this super helpful resource that breaks down home fire safety tips in a kid-friendly way. It’s a great reminder for all of us to have those chats and practice our plans together. How do you talk to your kids about safety?
